title: Ownership: moves, Copy and clone
hints: Look at the README's 'New syntax' table. Every body is one to six lines, and only `photocopy` needs `.clone()`.

Ideas: a parameter you want to change must be declared `mut` (`mut wallet: Vec<Ticket>`); `pop()` already returns an `Option`; a `for` loop over the Vec *by value* hands you each owned ticket to push into one of two new Vecs; `nudge` builds a new `Point`; `photocopy` clones, then appends to the clone.
Compiler says E0382 'use of moved value'? You used a name after giving it away: return it (or what you built from it) instead. E0596 'cannot borrow as mutable' means a missing `mut`.

Same shapes on other data: `fn sorted(mut v: Vec<i32>) -> Vec<i32> { v.sort(); v }` · `let mut evens = Vec::new(); for n in numbers { if n % 2 == 0 { evens.push(n) } }` · `Size { w: s.w * 2, h: s.h * 2 }` · `let mut loud = quiet.clone(); loud.push_str("!");`
